quantity: Households paying for a regular lawn-mowing service
scope: Australia, private households; regular means six or more paid visits a year; excludes body-corporate and commercial contracts

operators.why: GAP: people or businesses running a domestic mowing round. Official business counts for gardening services were not looked up in this session. Assessed from the trade being common in every suburb and town; surprised below 15,000 or above 70,000.

regular_customers_each.why: A full-time solo operator mows about 5 to 8 lawns a day, five days a week, mostly on a two to four week cycle: 50 to 160 regulars at capacity. Many operators are part-time or take one-off jobs, which pulls the typical book down.

share_household_customers.why: Some regular customers are agents managing rentals, body corporates and small commercial sites, which the quantity excludes. Bounds only.

anchors.name: cannot exceed the number of occupied separate houses: 6,710,582 at the 2021 Census (ABS QuickStats, read 2026-10-09) scaled up 10 per cent, the top of the assumed growth range
